title: Hover dossier composition
question: Which mini-dossier composition should the hover cards ship?

options.label: Cover-led stack
options.thesis: Full-width cover, then title, a three-cell KPI strip, short description, and exception chips.
options.viewport: Identity from the photo; ops facts scan as a horizontal strip under the title.
options.risk: Tall card if description and chips both stay.

options.label: Split dossier
options.thesis: Tall cover on the left; definition-list ops facts and status chips on the right.
options.viewport: Photo and facts share one glance without stacking height.
options.risk: Narrow fact column truncates longer labels.

options.label: Metric-first grid
options.thesis: Compact cover strip, then a 2×2 metric grid as the hero, with a one-line description and footer flags.
options.viewport: Numbers lead; photo is atmosphere, not the main mass.
options.risk: Can feel like a KPI widget if the grid gets too large.
